title: SQL & Relational Databases
intro: SQL interview questions are unavoidable in any backend interview — joins (inner, outer, cross, self), subqueries vs joins, window functions, indexes (B-tree vs hash, when an index hurts), the EXPLAIN plan, transaction isolation levels, ACID, normalization, sharding, partitioning, replication, connection pooling, and migration tools (Flyway, Liquibase). This page covers cross-database SQL fundamentals plus the operational questions that decide a senior interview. For Postgres-specific deep dives (window functions, JSONB, MVCC, partitioning), use the dedicated PostgreSQL page; for MongoDB, see the MongoDB page; for Redis, see the Redis page.
